# Arnav And Sahil Trading

> Bulk edible oil, sugar and City Gold tea wholesaler in Raghunathpur, Purulia, West Bengal, India. We supply kirana shops, retailers and wholesalers across West Bengal and Jharkhand. Short name: AST.

## What we sell
- Edible oil: mustard, soyabean, palm (palmolein), sunflower and rice bran oil in 15 kg tins, 15 L jars, pouch cartons and truckloads. Brands include Fortune, Sonali, Hiramoti, Dhara, Nepal Soya, Nepal Palm and others.
- Sugar: 50 kg bags, quintal lots and truckloads.
- Tea: City Gold tea in every pack size, from Rs 1 sachets to 250 gm. Dealerships open in new towns.
- Also: rice, atta, besan, dal, poppy seeds (posto), soya bari, soaps, detergents, salt and spices.

## Brands and our role
- Super stockist: City Gold Tea, Manpasand, Sargam, Parag Milk (Gowardhan)
- Distributor: Fortune (AWL) including Alife soaps, Sonali and Hiramoti mustard oil, Jyothy Labs (Ujala, Exo, Margo, Maxo), Ghadi

## Who we sell to
Wholesale only: kirana shops, retailers and sub-wholesalers. Bulk orders for weddings and functions are welcome.

## Where we deliver
Across West Bengal and Jharkhand. Regular routes in Purulia, Bankura and Paschim Bardhaman districts, including Raghunathpur, Adra, Kashipur, Para, Anara, Dubra, Cheliyama, Purulia, Bankura, Asansol, Durgapur and Barakar. In Jharkhand: Dhanbad, Bokaro, Chas and Jamshedpur.

## How to order
Oil and sugar rates change daily, so we quote on WhatsApp for your item and quantity. No minimum order. First orders from new shops are on cash or advance.

## Hours
Saturday to Thursday: 9:30 am to 7:30 pm
Friday: 9:30 am to 1:00 pm
